zh: message digest：哈希函数对任意长消息算出的固定长度输出。
truncated message digest：取全长度摘要左端若干比特的缩短结果。
collision resistance：难以找到产生同一摘要的两个消息，期望强度为摘要长之半。
preimage resistance：难以由摘要值求得能产生它的消息。
MacTag：HMAC 的输出标记，截断使用时不得少于 32 比特。
Hash-based KDF：以批准哈希或 HMAC 派生密钥材料的函数。
en: Message digest: the fixed-length output of a hash function over an arbitrary-length message.
Truncated message digest: the shortened result taken from the left end of the full digest.
Collision resistance: the difficulty of finding two messages with one digest, half the digest length in expectation.
Preimage resistance: the difficulty of recovering a message from its digest value.
MacTag: the HMAC output value, with a 32-bit floor when truncated.
Hash-based KDF: a key derivation function built on an approved hash function or HMAC.
